$description: CommandMenu (platform/components/CommandMenu, library wave 5, lane C): its component tokens. The field is SearchField's; the rows follow the menu (height, text, group labels) with the Combobox active fill; nothing here adds a color.

command-menu-gap.$description: CommandMenu: the space between the page row, the field and the list.

command-menu-page-gap.$description: CommandMenu: the space between Back and the page name.

command-menu-page-min-height.$description: CommandMenu: the page row height (the inline-action role of its Back button).

command-menu-page-title-font-family.$description: CommandMenu: the page name, in the label face.

command-menu-group-label-text.$description: CommandMenu: a group heading (as the menu group label).

command-menu-group-label-font-size.$description: CommandMenu: a group heading size (as the menu group label).

command-menu-group-label-font-weight.$description: CommandMenu: a group heading weight (as the menu group label).

command-menu-group-label-padding-block-s.$description: CommandMenu: the space above a group heading.

command-menu-group-label-padding-block-e.$description: CommandMenu: the space under a group heading.

command-menu-item-font-size.$description: CommandMenu: a command label size (as the menu item).

command-menu-item-min-height.$description: CommandMenu: a command row height (the standard control role, as the menu item).

command-menu-item-padding-block.$description: CommandMenu: the space above and under a row with a description.

command-menu-item-padding-inline.$description: CommandMenu: a row inline padding (as the menu item).

command-menu-item-gap.$description: CommandMenu: the space between a row icon, text, shortcut and chevron.

command-menu-item-radius.$description: CommandMenu: a row corners (as the Combobox options).

command-menu-item-active-background.$description: CommandMenu: the active row fill (as the Combobox active option).

command-menu-icon-color.$description: CommandMenu: a row icon and chevron.

command-menu-status-text.$description: CommandMenu: the Loading and No results rows (as the Combobox empty row).

command-menu-status-font-size.$description: CommandMenu: the Loading and No results size.

command-menu-status-padding-block.$description: CommandMenu: the space above and under the Loading and No results rows.
